title: Expert Council on Well-Being and AI
summary: OpenAI’s new Expert Council on Well-Being and AI brings together leading psychologists, clinicians, and researchers to guide how ChatGPT supports emotional health, especially for teens. Learn how their insights are shaping safer, more caring AI experiences.
body: OpenAI’s new Expert Council on Well-Being and AI brings together leading psychologists, clinicians, and researchers to guide how ChatGPT supports emotional health, especially for teens. Learn how their insights are shaping safer, more caring AI experiences.
summaryZh: OpenAI组建了由心理学家和临床研究人员组成的“心理健康与AI专家委员会”，旨在指导ChatGPT如何更安全地支持用户的心理健康，特别是针对青少年群体建立健康的AI交互体验。

aiReview.reasonZh: OpenAI成立专门委员会指导大模型在青少年心理健康和情感支持方面的安全应用。
